outcome: Umbilical yellow-green colored, foamy fecaloid drainage
Umbilical cord tissue compatible with cherry-colored mucosa
cohort: A term male newborn was hospitalized due to transient tachypnea of the newborn and presented with umbilical yellow-green colored, foamy fecaloid drainage.
finding: A rare neonatal patent omphalomesenteric duct anomaly presenting with fecaloid umbilical drainage was diagnosed and successfully treated surgically in a term male newborn, resulting in complete recovery.
